card.name: Start of the word intolerable
card.fires_on: The first piece of "intolerable" ("intoler") in dose-modification text, e.g. "intolerable side effects" or "intolerable adverse reaction". It also fires weakly on words like "is" after a subject describing something unacceptable.

modes.label: Intolerable reactions
modes.description: The start of "intolerable" before side effects, toxicities or adverse reactions, usually after "if" or "or".
modes.example: If your child has<< intoler>>able side effects from any medicine, call

modes.label: Verb after a bad-thing subject
modes.description: A verb or noun that follows a subject describing something unacceptable, and that is followed by a judgment such as serious or fatal.
modes.example: Any kind of cheating<< is>> a serious offense and will be dealt with

card.writes: It promotes words meaning "cannot" or "not allowed", which fits text about something that can't be accepted.
card.plain: It spots the start of "intolerable" in advice about side effects that a patient cannot put up with.
